verdict.rationale: Claude Code explicitly documents a 'GitHub Code Review' feature that provides automatic code review on every PR, plus CI-based automated code review/issue triage via GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD, scheduled 'morning PR reviews', and reusable /review-pr skills/checklists in CLAUDE.md. This is a first-party documented, named capability directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the automatic PR review actually triggers contextual feedback in practice, and more detail on setup/configuration beyond the docs mention.
